mentions.name: Claude movie-taste prediction game
mentions.description: A personal game played with Claude in which it asks questions about movies the user has seen, predicts their answers, gets graded, and builds a theory of their movie taste that reliably recommends movies and shows they enjoy.
mentions.source_excerpt: Privately I've been running a "game" for the past couple months with claude where it asks me questions about movies I've seen, tries to predict my answers, I grade the answers, and then it builds a theory of my movie taste.
